WITH currency_groups AS (
  SELECT CurrencyUnit, COUNT(*) AS CountryCount
  FROM Country
  WHERE CurrencyUnit IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CurrencyUnit) <> ''
  GROUP BY CurrencyUnit
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
), ranked AS (
  SELECT c.CurrencyUnit, c.ShortName,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CurrencyUnit ORDER BY c.ShortName) AS rn
  FROM Country c
  JOIN currency_groups g ON g.CurrencyUnit = c.CurrencyUnit
)
SELECT CurrencyUnit, country_count AS CountryCount,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN ShortName END) AS Country1,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN ShortName END) AS Country2,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN ShortName END) AS Country3
FROM ranked
JOIN currency_groups USING (CurrencyUnit)
WHERE rn <= 3
GROUP BY CurrencyUnit, country_count
ORDER BY CurrencyUnit;
